text:
alex: CI on main is red for the nightly integration build, got a decrypt error in the secrets step. failing job: https://ci.internal/reports/1123 :frowning:
ci-bot: job #1123 failed on runner aws-us-east-1 (seen in /builds/1123)
alex: log snippet: ```Error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = access to secret 'projects/redwood/secrets/ci/github-actions' denied``` 
sophia: ok tagging @ravi since this looks like KMS / secret access
ravi: looking. quick check — is this just the runner SA losing the kmsCryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter role? can someone paste the git sha of the last infra change? 
jamie: last infra PR that touched KMS bindings was #7891 merged ~2d ago by infra-ci-bot. not sure what it changed exactly
alex: I bisected locally: reverting infra PR #7891 makes the decrypt step succeed in a repro run (locally with same service account). so looks correlated.
sophia: can you paste the KMS policy check you ran? useful for on-call to triage
ravi: ran: ```gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-key/cryptoKeys/gha-secrets --format=json``` output showed members list and the github runner SA was missing. the binding used to include: "serviceAccount:github-actions@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" but it's not there now.
ops-bot: audit log event: principal "infra-ci-bot" changed IAM policy on cryptoKey gha-secrets at 2024-05-18T02:13:04Z (change id abc123)
jamie: infra PR #7891 removed a generic binding and replaced it with per-project tokens, but looks like we never added the new SA mapping for gha-secrets. my bad, introduced a regression.
alex: fix plan: re-add the binding temporarily and then follow up with a narrower mapping. who can run the fix? 
sophia: @ravi can you apply the IAM add and trigger a rerun? keep it pinned to the exact key and reason in change description
ravi: running command now: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-key/cryptoKeys/gha-secrets --member='serviceAccount:github-actions@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' --condition=None``` will open a small CL for audit.
ci-bot: re-run requested for job #1123 by ravi
ravi: rerun triggered, watching logs...
ci-bot: job #1123 rerun succeeded ✅
alex: green! thanks all. quick postmortem note: infra PRs that modify KMS bindings need a checklist item to add per-service mappings. filed follow-up: https://tracker.internal/issue/4521
sophia: small ops reminder: when touching org-level IAM, please leave a rollback path and add on-call in PR description :thumbsup:
jamie: will add that checklist to the infra PR template. apologies for the break — learned a lesson.
alex: closing the slack thread, if the job flakes again we'll open a longer postmortem. :eyes:
